brief: Thundertree, abandoned settlement at the edge of Neverwinter Wood. Round stone tower and attached cottage crown a low hill in the background, tower roof partly ruined. Daylight and gray-green forest atmosphere, faint old ash. No visible dragon, cultists, hidden blights, zombies or dungeon-style cave architecture.
